WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS "orders.net"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__customers__discount_min AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
    CAST(MIN(customers.discount) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.discount_min"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM orders AS orders
      WHERE
        customers.id = orders.customer_id AND NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__customers__discount_max AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
    CAST(MAX(customers.discount) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.discount_max"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM orders AS orders
      WHERE
        customers.id = orders.customer_id AND NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    regions.name,
    customers.tier
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.customers.tier",
  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.net",
  _base."orders.n",
  _cm_orders__customers__discount_min."customers.discount_min" AS "orders.mind",
  _cm_orders__customers__discount_max."customers.discount_max" AS "orders.maxd"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
  AND _base."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.tier"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__discount_min
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_min."customers.regions.name"
  AND _base."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_min."customers.tier"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__discount_max
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_max."customers.regions.name"
  AND _base."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_max."customers.tier"
LIMIT 21

args.message: For each order I took the amount and subtracted the ordering customer's discount, then added these up by region and customer tier. The last column repeats the total for the whole region on each row. Region comes from the customer's own region link (customers.region_id joined to the regions table). Orders without a customer were left out; the 5,010 orders that have one all match a customer record. The discount is a flat amount (0 to 10), not a percentage. Customers with no known region form the null group, which only has silver-tier customers.
